data.description:
Friends Ladies PG in JP Nagar 2nd Phase offers a perfect living space for students and working professionals. Conveniently located in one of Bangalore's most well-connected residential areas, the PG provides easy access to metro stations, bus stops, educational institutions, IT hubs, hospitals, supermarkets, restaurants, and shopping centers. JP Nagar 2nd Phase is known for its excellent connectivity, peaceful surroundings, and proximity to major business districts.

Our PG offers clean and spacious rooms with single, double, and triple sharing options, along with modern amenities including Wi-Fi, fully furnished rooms, attached bathrooms, daily housekeeping, nutritious home-style food, 24/7 water and power backup, CCTV surveillance, secure entry, laundry facilities, and ample parking. We prioritize safety, hygiene, and a friendly environment to ensure you feel at home.

Whether you're relocating to Bangalore for work or studies, Friends Ladies PG provides a hassle-free and comfortable stay at affordable prices. Contact us today to book your room and experience a safe and convenient living environment in the heart of JP Nagar 2nd Phase.
